apps.name: Asterion Veyra
apps.localizedDescription: Personal AI assistant with voice, notes and explicitly paired desktop access. Choose a supported response source and pair only the desktop you intend to use. Requires iOS 26 or later and a supported signing/container setup. Published build and automated checks are verified; installation and behavior on your physical device remain untested by this catalog.
